Tesla has dropped a new teaser for its much-anticipated Roadster high-performance EV. The teaser showcases what appears to be an LED light bar at the front of the vehicle, with a cryptic message from Tesla saying, "See you next week." The reveal is set for Oct. 1. Additionally, Musk confirmed that the Semi Truck volume production has commenced.

Tesla’s FSD system has come under scrutiny after it exceeded the legal speed limit on 55% of the Brussels road segments in a newly published test. This comes just before a possible EU vote that could determine the system’s operation across Europe.
